summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting positive interim results from the AZUR-1 phase II trial of Jemperli (dostarlimab) in dMMR/MSI-H locally advanced rectal cancer. The trial met its primary objective of sustained clinical complete response at 12 months. No financial terms, deal structure, or special-situation elements are present — the filing is a routine clinical trial update, not a corporate transaction or event-driven catalyst. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or restructuring. The document is a standard foreign private issuer report of material non-financial information.
